chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from one of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from the one who narrated it, said:

Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), when he was given the good news of a birth, did not ask, 'Is it a male or a female?' until he said, 'Is it unimpaired?' So if it was unimpaired, he said, 'The Praise is for Allah who did not create from me anything deformed.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn ask when told about a birth?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn’s (AS) prioritization of physical integrity (*sawi*) over gender, reflecting the Shia emphasis on gratitude for sound creation rather than societal preferences. The phrase 'not creating anything deformed from me' underscores the theological concept of *tawhid* in creation, attributing the child's wholeness directly to Allah’s will. This practice serves as a model for believers to cultivate contentment with divine decree, focusing on health and completeness as primary blessings.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from one of our companions, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from the one who narrated it, said,

‘Whenever Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was given the good news of a birth did not ask, ‘Is it a male or a female, until he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Is it unimpaired?’ So if it was unimpaired, said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who did not Create from me<sup>asws</sup> anything deformed’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from certain persons of our people from Muhammad ibn Sinan from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “

Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When one receives the news of the birth of his child one must not ask, “Is it a boy or a girl?’ One must ask, ‘Is it of complete physical condition?’ If the child is of complete physical condition one must say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah who has not created from me a defective child.’”
